{{Top|leg}}
'''Spade rays''' were [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[biot]]s that were mainly used as shovels. However, during a [[Incident in the Nursery|revolt]] by [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] in the [[Nursery]] on a [[Sh'rip Sh'pa|seedship]], spade rays were used as makeshift catapults and as blunt weapons by the slaves of the Yuuzhan Vong.
